title: Center for History, Culture & Art

services.name: Events & Exhibits
services.desc: HCA events and exhibits are hosted throughout the year to promote appreciation and awareness of history, culture and art. HCA is dedicate to arts education and artistic enrichment and aims to encourage the appreciation of Apalachicola history, culture and art among artists and the community of Apalachicola. By providing the general public the opportunity to participate in visual arts programs, HCA encourages the capabilities of artists and aspiring artists from both the local and national art community by teaching the fundamentals of representational art. blurb: The mission of Apalachicola Center for History, Culture & Art is to teach that the arts continue to define civilization. Housed in one of the two remaining 1836 Cotton Exchange Warehouses, the museum is led by its Board and its Director.
